Agita is the Community & Social Media Coordinator at Percona. Currently she's behind the PerconaBytes accounts, and her favorite part of the job is taking pictures of all the memes and oddities in and out of conferences. With XP in DevOps and open source, she is climbing to the top of the Percona hills, one cliff at a time. 🐐
